prp.objective: Create src/settingsLoader.ts: a pure, Pi-free, never-throwing leaf module exporting loadMulliganSettings(opts?: { cwd?: string; isTrusted?: boolean }): unknown that reads the global ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (via os.homedir()) and, ONLY when opts.isTrusted === true, the project-local <cwd>/.pi/settings.json; extracts the `mulligan` own-key from each parsed file; applies project-local-over-global TOP-LEVEL REPLACE precedence (NOT deep-merge — spec/09 §1 'project-local wins'); and returns the merged `mulligan` value (type unknown) or undefined when neither file contributes a mulligan key. Missing/unreadable files are silently skipped; malformed JSON emits console.warn('[mulligan] settings: <path> unreadable: <msg>') and is skipped; non-object `.mulligan` values are returned as-is so config.ts:validateConfig can coerce. The module imports only node: builtins (fs/path/os) — NO pi, NO config, NO log — so it is fully unit-testable with tmp-dir fixtures. This is the foundation that lets P1.M1.T2.S1 call setConfig(loadMulliganSettings(opts)) at factory load and on every session_start, fixing BUG-001 (inert config) and BUG-006 (/reload).
implementationSteps: Task 1 — CREATE src/settingsLoader.ts as a pure Pi-free leaf: import ONLY node:fs (readFileSync), node:path (join), node:os (homedir). NO @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent import, NO local './' imports. Lead the file with a block comment citing spec/09 §1, architecture/external_deps.md §1-§2, and design_decisions.md BUG-001 (match the heavy-doc style of markers.ts/config.ts).
Export the type: export type LoadMulliganSettingsOptions = { cwd?: string; isTrusted?: boolean };
Implement a private isRecord(v) helper mirroring config.ts:isRecord (typeof==='object' && !==null && !Array.isArray).

Implement a private mulliganValueIfPresent(obj) helper: return obj.mulligan when isRecord(obj) && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj,'mulligan') (so {mulligan:null}/{mulligan:0} count as PRESENT); else undefined.

Implement a private warnUnreadable(filePath, err) helper that does try { console.warn(`[mulligan] settings: ${filePath} unreadable: ${err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)}`); } catch { /* never throw */ } — mirroring config.ts:warnConfig and log.ts:writeStderrFallback.

Implement a private readMulliganKey(filePath) helper: try { return mulliganValueIfPresent(JSON.parse(readFileSync(filePath,'utf8'))); } catch (e) { warnUnreadable(filePath,e); return undefined; } — catches ENOENT/EACCES/EISDIR and JSON SyntaxError (incl. JSONC comments) uniformly.

Implement the public export function loadMulliganSettings(opts?): read global via readMulliganKey(join(homedir(),'.pi','agent','settings.json')); if (opts?.isTrusted===true && typeof opts?.cwd==='string') read local via readMulliganKey(join(opts.cwd,'.pi','settings.json')) and, when localMulligan !== undefined, RETURN localMulligan (top-level replace — null/non-object wins as-is); otherwise return globalMulligan. No caching. Never throws (all fs/JSON ops are inside readMulliganKey's try/catch).

Task 2 — CREATE test/settingsLoader.test.ts: import from 'vitest'; node:fs {mkdtempSync,rmSync,mkdirSync,writeFileSync}; node:os {tmpdir}; node:path {join}; and { loadMulliganSettings } from '../src/settingsLoader.js'. Also import { DEFAULT_CONFIG, validateConfig } from '../src/config.js' for the consumer-contract assertion.

At the top of the test file, vi.mock('node:os', ...) with a mutable homedir() so each test can point the global path at a fresh tmp dir (SPIKED: vitest hoists vi.mock and the module-under-test picks up the redirected homedir). Expose a setHome(p) helper via the factory closure (or use vi.mocked(homedir).mockReturnValue per test).

Adopt the test/log.test.ts fixture shape: two tmp dirs per test (home + cwd) via mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'mulligan-sl-...')) in beforeEach; rmSync(...,{recursive:true,force:true}) in afterEach for BOTH. Add a writeSettings(dir, relPath, objOrJson) helper that mkdirSync({recursive:true}) the parent then writeFileSync (string or JSON.stringify).

Write one it() per behavioral case: (1) no files → undefined; (2) global-only → global mulligan; (3) local-only trusted → local mulligan; (4) BOTH → LOCAL REPLACES GLOBAL (assert {b:2} not {a:1,b:2}); (5) isTrusted:false AND undefined → global (local never read); (6) local mulligan:null wins → returns null, and validateConfig(null)===DEFAULT_CONFIG; (7) missing file → undefined, no throw, no warn; (8) malformed global JSON → vi.spyOn(console,'warn').mockImplementation, assert exactly one warn with prefix '[mulligan] settings:' containing the global path, returns local-or-undefined; (9) malformed local (trusted, global valid) → returns global, one warn for local path; (10) non-object top-level ([1,2,3] or 42) → undefined; (11) non-object .mulligan (42 / 'off') returned as-is; (12) unrelated keys (packages/defaultModel) NOT leaked — only mulligan returned; (13) opts omitted → global-only, no throw; (14) loadMulliganSettings()===undefined → validateConfig(undefined) deepEquals DEFAULT_CONFIG; (15) NEVER throws — wrap adversarial calls (bad cwd dir, etc.) in expect(()=>...).not.toThrow().

Run Level 1 gate: npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json (baseline verified GREEN). Run Level 2 gates: npx vitest run test/settingsLoader.test.ts then npm test (confirm 635-test baseline + new tests, zero regressions). Do NOT modify src/index.ts or src/config.ts (scope boundary — wiring is P1.M1.T2.S1).

successCriteria.description: src/settingsLoader.ts exports loadMulliganSettings and the exported type LoadMulliganSettingsOptions = { cwd?: string; isTrusted?: boolean }.

loadMulliganSettings returns the merged mulligan value with project-local-over-global TOP-LEVEL REPLACE precedence: when both files have a mulligan key, the LOCAL value is returned verbatim (no deep-merge).
The local file is read ONLY when opts.isTrusted === true (strict); isTrusted false/undefined never reads local (returns global).
loadMulliganSettings NEVER throws: missing/unreadable file is silently skipped; malformed JSON emits exactly one console.warn with the prefix '[mulligan] settings: <path> unreadable:' and is skipped.
When no file has a mulligan key, loadMulliganSettings returns undefined, and validateConfig(undefined) deepEquals DEFAULT_CONFIG (the BUG-001 no-config baseline).
A non-object .mulligan (e.g. 42, 'off', null) is returned AS-IS; {mulligan:null} counts as a present key so local null replaces global.
Unrelated top-level keys (packages, defaultModel, etc.) are NOT leaked — only the mulligan value is returned.
src/settingsLoader.ts imports ONLY node: builtins (fs/path/os); it has ZERO imports from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and ZERO local './' imports (pure, unit-testable leaf).
src/index.ts and src/config.ts are NOT modified by this task (wiring is P1.M1.T2.S1 — scope boundary respected).

DOCS impact surfaced: README §3 documents this read behavior; it becomes true once P1.M1.T2.S1 wires setConfig(loadMulliganSettings(...)). No README edit in this task (Mode B changeset-level sync deferred to the final task).
